note.note:
I cannot generate the requested Problem List Clinical Note without the actual content of the transcript and the DDx JSON. Please provide:

- The full transcript (doctor–patient dialogue).
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) JSON used to inform reasoning.

Once provided, I will produce:

- Consult Summary: two-line summary.
- Problem List with Issue 1–3, including timeline, symptoms, exam findings, social history, meds, PMH, and the DDx-consistent differential with Likelihood tags.
- Medications, Allergies, Past Medical History, Social History, Preventative History.
- Physical Examination findings.
- Plan with actions and follow-up.
- Document quality checks (missing elements, transcript/DDx conflicts, transcript quality).

Notes:
- I will extract only clinically relevant details from the transcript/DDx and will not infer data not present.
- If a medication is mentioned without dose/route/frequency, I will record the name with “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- If the transcript and DDx conflict, I will include both and mark “conflict noted.”
- I will use American English, concise professional tone, and follow the exact structure you specified.
